# Google Maps Timeline Visualizer

> A free, privacy-focused tool to visualize your Google Maps Timeline location history — upload your data and explore your travels in the browser.

Google Maps Timeline Visualizer lets you import your exported Google location
history and view it as an interactive map and travel summary. Processing happens
in the browser; the tool is independent and not affiliated with Google. Content
may be quoted with attribution and a link.
